connectorUiConfig.title: SecurityScorecard Factor Scores
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown:
The SecurityScorecard Factor Scores connector ingests daily per-factor security scores from the [SecurityScorecard](https://securityscorecard.com) API into Microsoft Sentinel. For each company in the specified portfolio, it collects scores across 10 security categories — DNS Health, IP Reputation, Network Security, Application Security, Patching Cadence, Endpoint Security, Social Engineering, Hacker Chatter, Leaked Information, and Cubit Score — from the `/companies/{domain}/history/factors/score` endpoint. Factor scores enable granular trend analysis and alerting on specific security weaknesses.

Supports API Key authentication.

For more information, visit [SecurityScorecard API Docs](https://securityscorecard.readme.io/reference/introduction).

graphQueries.baseQuery: {{graphQueriesTableName}} | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d) | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)

sampleQueries.description: All factor scores, most recent first
Domains with weak network security (last 7 days)
sampleQueries.query: {{graphQueriesTableName}} | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | mv-expand factor = Factors | extend FactorName = tostring(factor.name), FactorScore = toint(factor.score) | where FactorName == "network_security" and FactorScore < 80 | project Domain, FactorScore | sort by FactorScore asc

sampleQueries.description: Factor score trends per domain (last 30 days)
sampleQueries.query: {{graphQueriesTableName}} | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d) | mv-expand factor = Factors | extend FactorName = tostring(factor.name), FactorScore = toint(factor.score) | summarize AvgScore = avg(FactorScore) by Domain, FactorName | sort by AvgScore asc

resourceProvider.permissionsDisplayText: Read and Write permissions are required.

customs.name: SecurityScorecard API Key
customs.description: A SecurityScorecard API key with access to the Portfolio and Factor Score History endpoints is required. Generate one from your SecurityScorecard account under **Settings → API**.

instructionSteps.title: Step 1 - Obtain credentials
instructionSteps.description:
To connect SecurityScorecard Factor Scores to Microsoft Sentinel, you will need:

1. **API Key** — In the SecurityScorecard platform, navigate to **My Settings → API** and generate or copy your API key.
2. **Portfolio ID** — The unique identifier of the portfolio you want to monitor. Find it in the URL when viewing a portfolio (e.g., `https://platform.securityscorecard.io/#/portfolios/<portfolio-id>`).

instructionSteps.title: Step 2 - Connect SecurityScorecard Factor Scores to Microsoft Sentinel
instructionSteps.description:
Enter your SecurityScorecard API key and Portfolio ID below.

>**NOTE:** Your API key is stored securely as a workspace secret and is never logged.
